gloss: half the number; half of the total

definitions.gloss: half the number; half of a group or total
definitions.explanation: Half of a countable set of people or things. Used in statistics, voting, and survey reports, where the related thresholds {過半数|かはんすう} (a majority) and {半数以上|はんすういじょう} (half or more) matter.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}の{半数|はんすう}が{女性|じょせい}だ。
examples.english: Half of the participants are women.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}の{半数|はんすう}{以上|いじょう}が{在宅|ざいたく}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: More than half of the employees work from home.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}によると、{回答者|かいとうしゃ}の{半数|はんすう}{近|ちか}くがこの{制度|せいど}を{知|し}らなかった。
examples.english: According to the survey, close to half of the respondents did not know about this system.

notes:
{半|はん} (half) + {数|すう} (number). Counts members of a set, so it is used with people, votes, and items — not with amounts like water or money, where {半分|はんぶん} is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半数|はんすう}{以上|いじょう}: half or more, more than half
- {半数|はんすう}{近|ちか}く: close to half
- {過半数|かはんすう}: a majority (more than half; the voting threshold)
- {半数|はんすう}を{占|し}める: to account for half

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {半分|はんぶん}: half — the everyday word, used for dividing a single thing ({半分|はんぶん}{食|た}べる)
- {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}: one half — the fraction, used in arithmetic and measurements
- {過半数|かはんすう}: majority — strictly more than half, the term used for resolutions and elections
